# GPU Draw and MSAA Attribution Plan

> Use superpowers:executing-plans inline in the existing audit branch; one fresh final reviewer.

**Goal:** Attribute the expensive production RenderPass and MSAA blits in Alkaid/W26, then select a bounded optimization only if measurements support one.
**Architecture:** Extend a separate copy of the external production probe. Keep the application and frozen production build unchanged. Nonoverlapping GPU queries measure RenderPass draw calls and gl.blitFramebuffer; plain and whole-pass windows remain separate controls.
**Tech Stack:** Three 0.182.0, native Chrome/AMD/ANGLE, Playwright/CDP, Node 24.17, existing Yandex S3 assets.
**Spec:** Last production-frame section of docs/project-audit-2026-10-21.md and the user's continuation of its next step.
**Base:** b36193626817edf97c980cfe312f8ebd45c81c07. Application source baseline remains 49148fae5a22aaf953faadfd13bc3ac2b7e384b3.

## Global Constraints

- Existing authorized inline workflow and branch; no new worktree, approval menu, dependency, automatic push or application quality change.
- Preserve all earlier artifacts. New files use gpu-draws-* names; production-frame-dist-2026-10-27 is read-only input. Verify source/build hashes before and after.
- Native Chrome,1280x720,DPR1; scenario13/actor135 and scenario12/actor127, same belt camera. 64-frame warmup,240 measured frames; movement2TU/360degrees by frame index.
- No GPU polling or framebuffer parameter queries during measured frames. GPU timer scopes must not nest. No inference of FPS or pure shader time from diagnostic scopes.
- No application edit without a specific hypothesis, regression and paired validation; unchanged-source diagnosis does not require a redundant full application test rerun.

## Review Focus

1. Overlapping GPU scopes or missing calls: smoke/full verifier checks unique per-frame scopes, explicit draw/blit counts and nonnested queries; zero/invalid elapsed samples fail.
2. Incorrect attribution/state: capture stable object/material/target identities and submitted instances; read actual renderbuffer sample count only after stopping; restores must match original descriptors and bindings.
3. Production provenance: compare frozen bundle to earlier manifest, application source to baseline, record all request origin/path/type without credentials; reject source requests including base-prefixed ones.
4. Misleading timing comparisons: retain raw per-frame values, sum only matching scopes within a frame before quantiles; no cross-window median subtraction or before/after gain claim.
5. Exceptional runs: exclusive result creation, retain failures, stop on WebGL/context/disjoint/asset errors; do not interpret failed or incomplete runs. Full injected-failure certification is outside this temporary probe.

### Task 1: Production draw/blit attribution

Files: new benchmark-results/heavy-scenes/{prepare-gpu-draws-2026-10-27.mjs,gpu-draws-2026-10-27.browser.js,run-gpu-draws-2026-10-27.mjs,archive-gpu-draws-2026-10-27.mjs}; update docs/project-audit-2026-10-21.md; create docs/benchmarks/gpu-draws-2026-10-27.json.

- [x] Prepare an isolated external probe/runner from the previous production harness, verify baseline provenance, preserve exact initial sources. Run a native smoke requesting attribution mode before adding it; expect only Unknown mode, not app diagnostics.
- [x] Add attribution mode with RenderPass draw and all-pass blit queries, captured identities/instances/targets, post-window hardware sample reads, and descriptor restoration checks. Smoke must complete8frames with nonempty draw/blit sets and clean diagnostics.
- [x] Run both scenes serially: plain-moving before; passes-stationary; attribution-stationary; attribution-moving; passes-moving; plain-moving after. 240frames/window,64warmup; save screenshots and whole request paths. Verify data/poses/counters and unchanged input bundle.
- [x] Analyze GPU material/geometry/blit costs with per-frame aggregation and distinguish actual measured targets from speculative fixes. If evidence supports a safe bounded application change, expand the plan with its regression and paired validation before editing it; otherwise document the actionable finding/next design.
- [ ] Embed raw evidence, sources, reports and checksums in archive; update audit. One independent read-only review, explicitly rule on every set-aside boundary, verify final metadata boundaries, local commit only.

Self-review: one task owns the probe/runner/report contracts. Native pre-implementation smoke pins the missing attribution capability; successful smoke/full runs and independent recalculation cover the diagnostic behavior. A production-code fix is not assumed in advance. This plan reuses the already built, unchanged artifact; rebuilding the same source is unnecessary and would obscure provenance.

Measured outcome:12windows/2880frames/52139GPUqueries,576cloud responses, clean diagnostics. Actual8xMSAA;9/7blits per frame, same-frame summed p50~14.5/10.8ms. A temporary empty-lens pass toggle was tested on frozen scenes with phase-reset histories and baseline-before/after controls. Controls match exactly; candidates differ58/100pixels (max3/23 channel levels), so the blind skip was rejected. No production code changed. Full report is gzip-embedded losslessly in the versioned archive to avoid15.8MB of repetitive pretty-printed data. Audit/archive integrity verification passed46evidence hashes plus32build files; final review and local commit remain.

scope: Single AMD/ANGLE D3D11 native headless Chrome155,1280x720,DPR1, one dense global-belt camera in each scene. Current-state attribution, not a before/after speedup or presentation FPS claim.

GPU scopes enclose renderer.renderBufferDirect or gl.blitFramebuffer, may contain submission gaps, and exclude uninstrumented surrounding operations. They do not isolate pure shader execution or GPU utilization. Pass and attribution windows are separate, so their medians are not subtracted or added as an exact frame decomposition.

Grouped values sum disjoint scopes within each frame before computing quantiles. Workload counts are submitted instances/elements, not unique visible pixels or visible actors. Near/L0/L1 denote existing stream names, not new quality settings.

Blit elapsed time includes both color and depth in a single command. No color/depth cost split or proof that every resolve is redundant. Actual sampled renderbuffers are RGBA16F8xMSAA; requested and allocated samples both recorded.

Movement is2TU/360degree yaw over240frames, not fixed real-time speed. Simulation continues, windows are sequential, cloud models may load during warmup; order/cache/thermal effects are not controlled for a performance improvement comparison.

New request log captures origin/path/type (no credentials or query strings), rejects root and base-prefixed source paths, and all recorded script paths match the production manifest. Individual cloud response bytes are not archived.

The empty-lens skip experiment is a temporary pass.enabled toggle on the existing build, no application implementation. Engine stopped, render delta0 and reset volume history phases made both baseline-before/after controls byte-identical. Candidate differs in58/100pixels; rejected under the image-preservation gate. No candidate speedup, HDR parity, MSAA0/4 support or active-lens correctness is claimed.

A changed multisample composition order is a plausible cause of the pixel differences, not a proven localization. Designing an MSAA/main-scene boundary and verifying its color/depth semantics is further work.

Native success/restoration and explicit timeout/context/disjoint checks are evidence for the recorded runs, not comprehensive injected-failure certification. Actual source and build unchanged. Existing full application suites/build were not rerun.
Menu counts reset to1geometry/0textures/0programs; this short profile does not prove long-duration heap/VRAM leak freedom. Rare previously seen long-frame causes remain open.
nextTarget: Design and validate fewer full-resolution8xMSAA resolves while preserving composition/depth, rather than blindly skipping an identity effect. Keep initial scene MSAA and image quality, and require synthetic depth/HDR checks, active-lens transitions, MSAA0/4/8 and paired native measurements before retaining application code.

review.scope: Two-file diagnostic/documentation snapshot; fresh read-only final review, no children or heavy reruns
review.assessment: Approved bounded diagnostic stage; rejection of blind empty-lens skip is supported
review.coverage: Plan, ledger, audit diff, complete profiling/experiment probes and runners, verifier, relevant application history/lens/composer and Three resolve code. Read-only integrity checks, baseline-source and prior-build-manifest comparison, raw GPU aggregate arithmetic and pixel comparisons; no screenshot viewing or injected failure testing.
declinedToJudge: Cross-device/browser performance: one native AMD/ANGLE setup and two routes
Presentation FPS or GPU utilization: timer scopes do not establish either
Pure shader execution time: elapsed scopes can include submission gaps
Exact whole-frame decomposition: surrounding renderer work is outside measured scopes
Cross-window subtraction or improvement estimates: instrumentation/conditions differ
Independent color versus depth cost: one blit command copies both
Redundancy of individual resolves: dependencies not proven removable
Unique visible asteroid counts: reported values are submitted instances/elements
General-purpose probe identity guarantees: inspected frozen pipeline, labels/indices and first-observed metadata
Comprehensive exceptional cleanup: no injected timeout/disjoint/context-loss coverage
Immediate cessation on every asynchronous diagnostic: runners reject at checkpoints
Universal network/source exclusion: observed manifest and specific path guard, not a security boundary
Exact future cloud replay: individual remote bytes not archived
Git-only image/build verification: PNG/RGBA/build remain local with hashes
Perceptual acceptability of image differences: rejection follows preservation gate
Root cause of image mismatch: MSAA composition plausible but not localized
Candidate speedup, HDR/depth parity, active lenses or MSAA0/4: not validated
Long-duration leaks and rare long-frame causes: short profile cannot close them
New application suite/build results: source and artifact unchanged
Independent visual appraisal: reviewer checked bytes/hashes, did not view images
Final amended metadata: verdict covers snapshot84045979 only
rulings: Keep conclusions limited to the recorded native device and routes. Other drivers/scenes can have different costs; no cross-device claim.
Keep render-entry intervals and GPU elapsed terminology. Do not convert them into presentation FPS or utilization; doing so would overstate user-visible benefit.
Keep submission-gap caveat. No attempt to rank pure shader instructions from these elapsed scopes; true shader busy time remains unknown.
Keep partial attribution explicit. Unmeasured renderer work remains outside draw/blit totals; sums are not an exhaustive frame budget.
Reject cross-window median subtraction and speedup estimates. A future candidate must use paired measurements; current figures establish costs only.
Report combined color+depth blit cost only. A depth-only saving cannot be inferred without another controlled measurement.
Keep every production resolve unchanged. A redesign must establish buffer consumers and image/depth equivalence before removing operations; premature removal can change output.
Use submitted workload counts, not unique visible-object claims. Multiple submissions/occlusion may make actual visible counts different.
Accept identity mapping only for this inspected frozen pipeline. Future probes must revalidate indices, labels, variants and rectangles; arbitrary graphs could merge or mislabel groups.
Accept successful restoration and explicit failure checks for these runs. Do not certify arbitrary thrown restoration errors or injected context loss; future failed runs remain inadmissible.

Accept checkpoint rejection: diagnostics make the report fail before acceptance, while partial failed evidence stays retained. This does not promise instantaneous stop or certify a reusable fail-fast framework.
Accept recorded manifest/path evidence for the run. The request guard is an instrumentation check, not a security mechanism for arbitrary schemes or executable injection.
Disclose remote-byte replay limits. Preserve revision, local build manifest, requests and raw observations; cloud/time variation can change future captures.

Accept embedded raw measurements/sources with local image/build hashes. Independent verification of historical image/build bytes needs the retained local artifacts; Git alone cannot supply those bytes.
Reject candidate by the stated exact-image gate without claiming visible severity. This can defer a perceptually acceptable optimization, but avoids changing acceptance criteria after seeing results.
Keep composition-order explanation a hypothesis. Localize color/depth differences before claiming that a new pipeline fixes their cause.
Do not run acceptance tests for a rejected production candidate or claim unmeasured benefit. Any later implementation needs HDR/depth, active-lens, MSAA0/4/8 and paired native evidence.
Leave memory-soak and rare-frame investigations open under item16. Menu counters and short captures cannot rule out leaks or explain earlier spikes.
Do not relabel historical tests as fresh. Source unchanged and frozen artifact verified; this stage's fresh evidence is native control/smoke/profile/image comparison plus integrity checks.
Attribute screenshot viewing to executor only. Reviewer verification is numerical; absence of an independent visual appraisal remains disclosed.

Preserve reviewed file copies and hashes; allow only review/provenance/timestamp additions and appended audit conclusion, verify boundaries and archive again, amend only this own unpublished documentation commit, no push.
